My recommendation

Buy the UGREEN DXP8800 Plus if your media library will run Plex or Jellyfin directly on the NAS. At approximately $1,370 diskless, it's a compelling choice with Intel Quick Sync and built-in 10GbE. Hardware transcoding in Plex requires Plex Pass.

Choose the Synology DS1825+ instead if you value mature storage software over transcoding performance, especially if you already have a separate Plex server.

One question that would help me narrow this down:

Storage only, with Plex running on another computer
